title: fraxinus lanuginosa f. velutina
intro: Fraxinus lanuginosa f. velutina, commonly known as Manchurian ash or Manchurian white ash, is a deciduous tree species native to East Asia, belonging to the family Oleaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing pain, fever, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Fraxinus lanuginosa f. velutina include its ability to stimulate circulation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit sedative effects, making it a potential treatment for various cardiovascular and neurological disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
